_source: Pathfinder Unchained skill unlocks (legacy.aonprd.com/unchained/skillsAndOptions/skillUnlocks.html). Keyed by base skill; the picker maps 'knowledge <field>' -> 'knowledge'. Each entry gives the benefit gained at 5/10/15/20 ranks in that skill.

acrobatics.5: You can move at normal speed through a threatened square without provoking an attack of opportunity by increasing the DC of the check by 5 (instead of moving at half speed).
acrobatics.10: You can use your Acrobatics modifier as your CMD against trip maneuvers, use an Acrobatics check in place of a Reflex save to avoid falling, and reduce falling damage.
acrobatics.15: You do not provoke attacks of opportunity when standing up from prone.
acrobatics.20: Double your Acrobatics result when jumping, and you never fall prone from falls as long as you are conscious.

appraise.5: You can detect whether an item is magical (DC 20) and reveal its properties (DC 25 + caster level), and you automatically identify non-written forgeries.
appraise.10: As a standard action you can determine the most expensive object a creature wears or wields (DC 20); you never make wildly inaccurate appraisals.
appraise.15: Determining the most expensive object is a move action, and you may substitute an Appraise check at -10 for a Will save against figments and glamers.
appraise.20: Identifying the priciest object is a move action, and observing an item grants a +2 circumstance bonus on steal and disarm checks against its bearer for 1 minute.

bluff.5: The penalty to Bluff a creature after a failed check is halved unless you failed by 5 or more.
bluff.10: You take no penalty to Bluff a creature after a failed check unless you failed by 5 or more.
bluff.15: Creatures magically attempting to read your thoughts, detect your alignment, or reveal when you are lying must succeed at a caster level check (DC 11 + your Bluff ranks) or the effect reveals nothing.
bluff.20: As a full-round action you can make a suggestion (as the spell, max 1 hour) to a creature within 30 feet (Will negates, DC 15 + Cha mod). This is an extraordinary mind-affecting compulsion.

climb.5: You are no longer denied your Dexterity bonus to AC when climbing.
climb.10: You gain a climb speed of 10 feet on surfaces with a Climb DC of 20 or lower.
climb.15: Your climb speed equals your base speed on surfaces of DC 20 or lower, and 10 feet on other surfaces.
climb.20: Your climb speed equals your base speed on all surfaces, and you gain a +8 racial bonus on Climb checks with both hands free.

craft.5: When crafting, double the result of your Craft check before multiplying by the item's DC.
craft.10: You do not ruin any of your raw materials unless you fail a Craft check by 10 or more.
craft.15: The result of your Craft check is how much work you complete each day, in silver pieces.
craft.20: You can craft magic armor, magic weapons, magic rings, and wondrous items using the normal Craft rules (no item-creation feat required for these).

diplomacy.5: The time required to influence a creature's attitude or gather information with Diplomacy is halved.
diplomacy.10: You can adjust a creature's attitude in 1 round at a -10 penalty; 1-minute adjustments add your Cha bonus to how long the attitude persists.
diplomacy.15: You can adjust attitude in 1 round with no penalty; 1-minute changes last days, and you can gather information in 10 minutes at -5.
diplomacy.20: 1-round attitude adjustments take no penalty, 1-minute changes last weeks, and you can gather information in 1d4 minutes with no penalty.

disable device.5: You can reduce the time to disarm a trap or open a lock by taking a -5 penalty per step (down to a swift action).
disable device.10: You can disarm magical traps at a -10 penalty, and with trapfinding you never accidentally trigger a trap even while performing its trigger action.
disable device.15: When attacked by a trap, you can attempt an immediate-action Disable Device check opposed by the trap's attack roll or save DC to take half or no damage.
disable device.20: Halve the penalties for quickly disarming, and with trapfinding you can take a -20 penalty to let allies benefit and disable a trap before it triggers (DC +10).

disguise.5: You can create a disguise in 1d3 minutes.
disguise.10: You can create a disguise in 1d3 rounds; taking the full time means no penalty for disguising gender, race, or age.
disguise.15: You can create a disguise as a full-round action.
disguise.20: You can create a disguise as a standard action, or combine it with a Bluff diversion to hide in plain sight.

escape artist.5: Take a -10 penalty to halve the time an Escape Artist check requires; escaping a grapple or pin is a move action, and escaping entangling spells is a standard action.
escape artist.10: You can escape any entangling effect as a standard action (DC = effect's save DC + 10), and you set the escape DC for ropes and bindings.
escape artist.15: You can escape entangling effects as a move action and suppress slow or paralysis as a standard action (DC = save DC + 20) for a short time.
escape artist.20: You can escape as an immediate action (DC = effect's DC/CMB + 10) and suppress slow or paralysis as a standard, move, or immediate action.

fly.5: A successful DC 20 Fly check lets you make a 45-degree turn without sacrificing movement.
fly.10: A DC 30 check lets you ascend at a 45-degree angle at full speed, and a DC 10 check treats falls after a midair collision as 10 feet shorter.
fly.15: A DC 30 check allows a 90-degree turn without sacrificing movement (or a 180-degree turn for 5 feet), and you are treated as one size larger versus wind.
fly.20: A DC 35 check lets you fly straight up at full speed, and you are treated as two size categories larger versus wind effects.

handle animal.5: Creatures you have trained gain a +2 bonus on Will saves while adjacent to you.
handle animal.10: Trained creatures gain the +2 Will bonus within 30 feet while they can clearly see you, and you can teach a trick in 1 day at DC +20.
handle animal.15: With a week and a DC 30 check you can train an animal to understand speech (as speak with animals); you can teach a trick in 1 day (DC +10) or 1 hour (DC +20).
handle animal.20: You can make your speech understandable to any animal for 24 hours (DC 30, or DC 40 for magical beasts/vermin), and teach tricks in as little as 1 minute.

heal.5: When you treat deadly wounds, the target recovers hit points and ability damage as if it had rested for a full day.
heal.10: When you treat deadly wounds, the target recovers as if it had rested a full day with long-term care.
heal.15: When you treat deadly wounds, the target recovers hit points and ability damage as if it had rested for 3 days.
heal.20: When you treat deadly wounds, the target recovers as if it had rested 3 days with long-term care.

intimidate.5: If you exceed the Intimidate DC by 10 or more, the target is frightened for 1 round and then shaken; a Will save (DC 10 + your ranks) negates the frightened condition.
intimidate.10: Exceed the DC by 10+ to make the target panicked for 1 round or frightened for 1d4 rounds (your choice), then shaken.
intimidate.15: Exceed the DC by 20+ to make the target cowering for 1 round or panicked for 1d4 rounds (your choice), then frightened.
intimidate.20: Exceed the DC by 20+ to make the target cowering for 1d4 rounds and then panicked.

knowledge.5: You gain one additional piece of useful information for every 5 ranks you possess in that Knowledge skill.
knowledge.10: After identifying a creature you gain a +1 competence bonus (increasing per 5 ranks) on attack rolls, opposed checks, skill checks, and caster level checks against creatures of that kind for 1 minute.
knowledge.15: You can reroll a failed Knowledge check at a -10 penalty, and the competence bonus also applies to saving throws against that creature type's special abilities.
knowledge.20: You can roll twice and take the better result on Knowledge checks.

linguistics.5: You can use Linguistics in place of Sense Motive to intercept secret messages, and gain a scaling insight bonus on Perception/Disable Device checks for written magical traps.
linguistics.10: Exceed a writing-examination check by 10 to learn its precise meaning, never draw false conclusions on a failure, and decipher spoken meaning at high DCs.
linguistics.15: You can decipher magical writings (DC 25 + caster level) as if using read magic, and gain a +2 bonus on Disable Device for identified magical traps.
linguistics.20: You decipher text at one page per round, and spending 1 minute per page lets you roll twice and take the better result.

perception.5: You remain alert to sounds even while asleep (the sleeping DC increase is halved), and the distance penalty is reduced to +1 per 20 feet.
perception.10: The distance penalty drops to +1 per 30 feet, and you gain a +5 bonus to notice or locate invisible creatures and objects.
perception.15: You remain alert to sounds in your sleep with no DC increase, and the distance penalty drops to +1 per 40 feet.
perception.20: You gain a +10 bonus to notice invisible creatures and objects, and the distance penalty drops to +1 per 60 feet.

perform.5: A DC 20 Perform check grants a +2 circumstance bonus on a Bluff, Diplomacy, Handle Animal, or Intimidate check.
perform.10: A DC 25 Perform check while casting an emotion or language-dependent spell increases its save DC by 1.
perform.15: A DC 30 Perform check while casting an emotion or language-dependent spell increases its caster level by 1 (choose this or the 10-rank ability).
perform.20: Choose Bluff, Diplomacy, or Intimidate; you may use the better result between Perform and that skill.

profession.5: When using Profession to earn income, you earn gold pieces (instead of half) equal to your check result each week.
profession.10: You can roll twice and take the better result on Profession checks, and you always take 10 when answering questions about your profession.
profession.15: You can attempt checks to earn income once per day instead of once per week.
profession.20: You may choose to roll once; if the result is less than 10, treat it as 10, and you always take 20 answering profession questions.

ride.5: Your mount gains a +2 bonus (increasing per 5 ranks) on Fortitude saves or Constitution checks to avoid becoming fatigued or exhausted.
ride.10: When you spur your mount, its speed increases by 20 feet and it gains a +2 bonus on Reflex saves and a +2 dodge bonus to AC.
ride.15: While mounted, you can substitute your Ride check for your CMD against bull rush, drag, overrun, reposition, and trip aimed at you or your mount.
ride.20: Spurring your mount increases its speed by 30 feet and grants a +4 bonus on Reflex saves and a +4 dodge bonus to AC.

sense motive.5: If aware of an opponent before initiative, you can attempt a Sense Motive check as part of initiative to gain a scaling initiative bonus.
sense motive.10: After conversing for 1 minute, you can read a creature's surface thoughts at a -20 penalty opposed by its Bluff (as detect thoughts).
sense motive.15: You can read surface thoughts after 1 round, and when attacked may attempt an immediate-action Sense Motive check to gain a +2 insight bonus to AC against that foe.
sense motive.20: You can read surface thoughts as a standard action, and a successful insight-bonus check negates the triggering attack.

sleight of hand.5: A successful Sleight of Hand check against a target's CMD grants a +2 circumstance bonus on your disarm or steal combat maneuver check.
sleight of hand.10: The penalty for a Sleight of Hand check (including drawing a hidden weapon) as a move action is reduced to -10.
sleight of hand.15: You can attempt a Sleight of Hand check (including drawing a hidden weapon) as a swift action at a -20 penalty.
sleight of hand.20: You take no penalty for using Sleight of Hand as a move action, and only a -10 penalty when using it as a swift action.

spellcraft.5: Identifying magic items takes 1 full round, and the time to learn a spell from a spellbook is halved.
spellcraft.10: You can identify magic items without using detect magic, though the DC is increased by 10.
spellcraft.15: Identifying magic items is a standard action, and learning a spell takes 1 minute per spell level.
spellcraft.20: When attempting a caster level check, you can attempt a Spellcraft check at -20 against the same DC; success grants a +2 circumstance bonus.

stealth.5: Reduce the Stealth penalty from sniping by 10.
stealth.10: Stealth penalties for moving at full speed are halved (including the 5-rank sniping ability).
stealth.15: After a successful Stealth-based attack, your target is denied its Dexterity bonus against all attacks you make before the end of your turn.
stealth.20: After a successful Stealth-based attack, your target is denied its Dexterity bonus against all your attacks before the beginning of your next turn.

survival.5: Reduce all nonlethal damage you take from heat, cold, starvation, or thirst by 1 point per 5 ranks.
survival.10: You can track creatures that leave no tracks (including flying/swimming creatures and those using trackless step or pass without trace) at a -20 penalty.
survival.15: Once per day you can spend 1 hour and succeed at a DC 30 check to gain cold or fire resistance 5 for 24 hours, sharing it with allies.
survival.20: You take only a -10 penalty when tracking creatures that leave no tracks.

swim.5: You gain a swim speed of 10 feet in water with a Swim DC of 15 or lower.
swim.10: Your swim speed equals your base speed in water of DC 15 or lower, and 10 feet in other water.
swim.15: You ignore the penalties for using slashing or bludgeoning weapons underwater, as freedom of movement.
swim.20: Your swim speed equals your base speed in all water, and you gain a +8 racial bonus on Swim checks with both hands free.

use magic device.5: You can use the aid another action to assist another creature's Use Magic Device check by succeeding at a check against the item's DC.
use magic device.10: Rolling a natural 1 while activating an item only gives you a -10 penalty on Use Magic Device checks with that item for 24 hours (instead of locking you out).
use magic device.15: You can emulate two races or two alignments simultaneously.
use magic device.20: After rolling a natural 1, you may reroll the check at a -10 penalty to activate the item (you must accept the second result).
